card.name: Digits inside numbers and years
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit or space partway through a multi-digit number, such as a year or range of years in history text, or a count after 'over'. Also seen on a few words near Armenian text.

modes.label: Digits in years
modes.description: A digit inside a year or year range, especially Ottoman or historical dates.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space after a word like 'over' just before a large figure.

modes.label: Near Armenian text
modes.description: The word Armenian or the space before Armenian script in word-origin notes.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a number, mostly years, where the next digits are still to come.
